title: Manage ads
content:
# Manage ads

Pause or resume X campaigns, line items and ads, change their budget and bid, and delete them.

import { Tab, Tabs } from 'fumadocs-ui/components/tabs';

After creation an X ad changes only in status, budget and bid. Targeting and creative stay as created.

## Pause or resume

`PUT /v1/ads/{adId}/status` pauses or resumes an ad. X has no per-ad switch, so it writes the switch of the ad's line item, which every promoted post in that line item shares.

<Tabs items={['Node.js', 'Python', 'curl']}>
<Tab value="Node.js">
```typescript
const { data: paused } = await zernio.adcampaigns.updateAdStatus({
  path: { adId: '66f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' },
  body: { status: 'paused' }
});
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="Python">
```python
paused = client.ad_campaigns.update_ad_status(
    ad_id="66f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0",
    status="paused",
)
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="curl">
```bash
curl -X PUT "https://zernio.com/api/v1/ads/66f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0/status" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "status": "paused" }'
```
</Tab>
</Tabs>

Response (`200`):

```json
{ "updated": 1, "skipped": 0, "status": "paused", "configuredStatus": null }
```

`configuredStatus` is always `null` on X, because X exposes no per-ad switch.

The campaign and line item keep their own switches:

- `PUT /v1/ads/campaigns/{campaignId}/status` with `platform: "twitter"` writes the campaign's switch.
- `PUT /v1/ads/ad-sets/{adSetId}/status` writes the line item's `entity_status`.

Pausing a campaign stops everything under it. Resuming it lets a line item deliver again only if its own switch is on.

## Change the budget

Send `budget: { amount, type }` on `PUT /v1/ads/{adId}`. Zernio reads where X holds the budget and writes it there, on the line item or on the campaign.

`PUT /v1/ads/ad-sets/{adSetId}` with `platform: "twitter"` changes a line item budget directly. `amount` is in whole currency units.

`PUT /v1/ads/campaigns/{campaignId}` changes a campaign budget, and `name` on it renames the campaign. When X holds the budget on the line item, a campaign budget returns `409`.

## Change the bid

`bidStrategy` and `bidAmount` on `PUT /v1/ads/ad-sets/{adSetId}` write the line item's bid:

| `bidStrategy` | X bid strategy |
|---------------|----------------|
| `LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP` | `AUTO` |
| `LOWEST_COST_WITH_BID_CAP` | `MAX`, with `bidAmount` |
| `COST_CAP` | `TARGET`, with `bidAmount` |

X decides which strategy the line item's objective allows: `TARGET` only on reach, followers and website clicks, and `MAX` not on reach or followers.

`name` on the same call renames the line item.

## Delete

`DELETE /v1/ads/{adId}` removes the promoted post on X and marks the ad `cancelled` in Zernio, keeping its history.

Its line item goes too, but only when Zernio created it and X lists no other promoted post in it.

The campaign follows on the same rule. If X refuses the promoted post delete, nothing else is touched.

`DELETE /v1/ads/campaigns/{campaignId}` deletes a whole campaign on purpose.

## If it fails

| Error | Cause | Fix |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `501` with code `feature_not_available` | `targeting` or `creative` sent to `PUT /v1/ads/{adId}` | Create a new ad with the change. |
| `400` with code `missing_required_field`, `param: "roasAverageFloor"` | `LOWEST_COST_WITH_MIN_ROAS` without `roasAverageFloor` | Use `LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP`, `LOWEST_COST_WITH_BID_CAP` or `COST_CAP`. |
| `422` with `param: "bidStrategy"` | A strategy outside the three X takes | Use `LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP`, `LOWEST_COST_WITH_BID_CAP` or `COST_CAP`. |
| `409` with code `invalid_field_value` | A campaign `budget` when the budget lives on the line item | Change the budget through the ad or line item. |
| `501` on a campaign duplicate | X campaigns cannot be duplicated | Create the campaign again to copy it. |
| `403` with code `ads_allowance_exceeded` | No payment method on file and 500 live ads reached | Add a card to resume. |
| `404` | The ad or campaign id is unknown | Read the ids from `GET /v1/ads/tree`. |
